text.en: This Act may be cited as the Gurkha Reserve Unit Short title Act.

(1) In this Act, unless the context otherwise re-Interpretation means the Commandant of the Unit Orders" means the General Orders of means a person who is either a Senior Officer, Subordinate Officer, or of the rank and file of the Gurkha Reserve Unit; "Senior Officer" means a member of the Gurkha of the rank of Second Lieutenant, Lieutenant, Captain, Major, Lieutenant Colonel or above and includes the Commandant; "Subordinate Officer" means a member of the Reserve Unit of the rank of Lance Corporal, Corporal, Sergeant, Warrant Officer Class Two and Warrant Officer Class One; B.L.R.O. 111984 6 CAP. 135 Gurkha Reserve Unit "Unit" means the Gurkha Reserve Unit; "weapons" includes firearms and ammunition. cap. 22 131 and 140 of the Penal Code the "an officer or constable in the Royal Brunei Police Force'' shall be deemed to include a member of the Gurkha

(3) In section 137 of the Penal Code the phrase "any deserter from the Royal Brunei Police Force" shall be deemed to include a deserter from the Gurkha Reserve Unit.

(4) In any Order made by His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan under section 83 of the Constitution of Brunei Darussalam 1959 the phrase "member of any Local Forces established under any written law" shall be deemed to include a member of the Gurkha Reserve Unit.

CONSTITUTION, DUTIES AND POWERS
The Gurkha Reserve Unit shall consist of such comof Senior Officers, Subordinate Officers and rank and file as His Majesty may direct and shall form an integral part of the Security Forces of Brunei.

(1) The organisation and administration of the Gurtion kha Reserve Unit shall subject to the orders and control of the Minister be vested in the Commandant of the Unit who shall be appointed by His Majesty.

(2) The powers and duties of the Commandant under this Act may be exercised and performed in the case of absence or incapacity of the Commandant by the next senior officer present in place of the Commandant. Gurkha Reserve Unit CAP. 135 7
